description: A React component implementing an enhanced video player with ReactPlayer, emoji reactions, sound effects, flying animations, and user interaction controls for a sports live stream platform.

methods.name: loadEmojis
methods.description: Fetches available emojis and reaction counts from API, updates state accordingly.

methods.name: initializeAudio
methods.description: Initializes Web Audio API context for sound effects.

methods.name: createEmojiSound
methods.description: Generates and caches an audio buffer for a given sound configuration.

methods.name: playEmojiSound
methods.description: Plays the sound associated with an emoji reaction.

methods.name: handleReady
methods.description: ReactPlayer event handler for when the video is ready.

methods.name: handleStart
methods.description: ReactPlayer event handler for when the video starts playing.

methods.name: handlePlay
methods.description: Sets state to indicate video is playing.

methods.name: handlePause
methods.description: Sets state to indicate video is paused.

methods.name: handleSeek
methods.description: Seeks video to a specific time based on user interaction.

methods.name: handleEmojiReaction
methods.description: Handles user emoji reactions, triggers flying animations, sound effects, API submission, and updates counts.
